identification: Carved timber ram standing on a rectangular timber plinth, vertical chisel-groove fleece, curled horn, whitewashed/grey wash finish, H43 x L40 cm. Rustic decorator/folk-art style, modern or mid-century, no maker identified.
marks_seen: No signature, stamp or label on any of the 3 photos (side views and a head close-up); only the Armitage paper tag on the plinth.
google_searches: carved wooden ram figure on plinth rustic folk art sculpture (Google): only generic Etsy/eBay/1stDibs ram carvings, nothing matching this piece or its maker.

entries.note: Large hand-carved sheep sculpture in solid hardwood by B K Carving, 11 bids; signed maker piece, not same item.
Elaine Frank Valletta signed standing ram folk art, 1998, large. Signed artist piece, listing from US marketplace.
Primitive antique hand-carved ram cheese press, different object.
Small vintage wooden ram on wheels figurine, carved painted; smaller.
Beech wood Good Shepherd statue with sheep, 18cm; category guide only.

viewing_check: Estimate $40-60, current bid $20 (plus 22% premium). No sold match for an unmarked carved ram of this size on eBay AU (4 searches); comparables range from $20 small figures to $100-400 for signed or large artist pieces. Check carving quality and whether any marking is under the plinth. Likely decorator value only, roughly $40-90. Bulky-ish (43x40cm) and fragile horns to post.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU: carved wooden ram (5 rows, none matching); wooden ram sculpture (0); wood ram figure (3, toys); carved wooden sheep (8); Terapeak US: hand carved wood ram folk art (40, truncated, picked closest).
flip_reason: No same-item sales found, comparables are signed or different items; typical decor ram roughly $40-90 vs current bid $20 plus 22% premium; margin under $200.
